caseNameFull: BRUGERE v. SLIDELL HEATH v. SLIDELL
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF LOUISIANA.-
attorneys: Mr. L. M. Day for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Thomas Allen Clarice for defendants in error.

opinions.author: Strong
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Strong

delivered the opinion of the court.

Both these eases are controlled by the decisions made in Bigelow v. Forrest, 9 Wall. 339, and in Day v. Micou, just decided, 18 Wall. 156.

Judgment in both eases Affirmed.
